targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Реферальные"
FROM iam.users u
JOIN iam.lead_sources ls ON ls.id = u.lead_source_id
WHERE ls.source_type = 'referral'
  AND u.telegram_id > 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Канальные"
FROM iam.users u
JOIN iam.lead_sources ls ON ls.id = u.lead_source_id
WHERE ls.source_type = 'channel'
  AND u.telegram_id > 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Без источника"
FROM iam.users u
WHERE u.lead_source_id IS NULL
  AND u.telegram_id > 0

SELECT
  date_trunc('week', u.created_at) AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN ls.source_type = 'referral' THEN 'Реферальные'
    WHEN ls.source_type = 'channel' THEN 'Канальные'
    ELSE 'Органика'
  END AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM iam.users u
LEFT JOIN iam.lead_sources ls ON ls.id = u.lead_source_id
WHERE u.telegram_id > 0
  AND u.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  COALESCE(u_ref.name, u_ref.username, u_ref.telegram_id::text) AS referrer,
  COUNT(u.telegram_id) AS invited
FROM iam.lead_sources ls
JOIN iam.users u ON u.lead_source_id = ls.id
JOIN iam.users u_ref ON u_ref.telegram_id = ls.created_by
WHERE ls.source_type = 'referral'
  AND u.telegram_id > 0
  AND u.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY referrer
ORDER BY invited DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  ls.label AS "Описание",
  ls.code AS "Код",
  ls.created_at::date AS "Создана",
  COALESCE(u_admin.name, u_admin.username) AS "Создал",
  COUNT(u.telegram_id) AS "Переходов"
FROM iam.lead_sources ls
LEFT JOIN iam.users u ON u.lead_source_id = ls.id AND u.telegram_id > 0
LEFT JOIN iam.users u_admin ON u_admin.telegram_id = ls.created_by
WHERE ls.source_type = 'channel'
GROUP BY ls.id, ls.label, ls.code, ls.created_at, u_admin.name, u_admin.username
ORDER BY ls.created_at DESC

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN ls.source_type = 'referral' THEN 'Реферальные'
    WHEN ls.source_type = 'channel' THEN 'Канальные'
    ELSE 'Органика'
  END AS source,
  c.value AS stage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_telegram_id) AS users
FROM iam.users u
LEFT JOIN iam.lead_sources ls ON ls.id = u.lead_source_id
JOIN integrations.user_cohorts uc ON uc.user_telegram_id = u.telegram_id
JOIN integrations.cohorts c ON c.id = uc.cohort_id AND c.type = 'Status'
WHERE u.telegram_id > 0
GROUP BY source, c.value
ORDER BY users DESC

SELECT
  date_trunc('week', u.created_at) AS time,
  COALESCE(ls.label, ls.code) AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM iam.users u
JOIN iam.lead_sources ls ON ls.id = u.lead_source_id
WHERE ls.source_type = 'channel'
  AND u.telegram_id > 0
  AND u.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
